name: Citizenship by Marriage for Foreign Wives of Somali Men

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign woman who marries a Somali citizen man acquires Somali citizenship automatically -- no equivalent automatic provision for a foreign man marrying a Somali woman was located in this build.

sources.title: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative -- Somali Citizenship Law No. 28 of 22 December 1962, Article 13: 'Any woman who is not a citizen and marries a citizen shall acquire Somali citizenship'; she retains it after the marriage's dissolution unless she loses it under the Article 10 grounds (voluntary foreign naturalization, formal renunciation, or continued foreign government service)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2-only sourcing limitation as so_citizenship_naturalisation.json. MARQUEE GENDERED FINDING, CONSISTENT WITH A PATTERN SEEN REPEATEDLY IN THIS DATASET (Qatar, Bahrain, Nigeria, Sudan, Pakistan): Article 13 grants AUTOMATIC citizenship to a foreign woman marrying a Somali man, on marriage itself -- selection_method is 'automatic' here, not 'assessed', because the statute's own text describes it as an operation-of-law acquisition rather than a discretionary grant. No search conducted in this build located any equivalent automatic provision for a foreign man marrying a Somali woman; such a man would instead need to pursue the ordinary naturalization route (so_citizenship_naturalisation.json, 7 years, or 2 years if his own mother happens to be Somali -- an unrelated reduced-period ground). This is one of the most starkly one-directional gendered citizenship-by-marriage provisions found in this dataset to date -- most comparable countries (Sudan, Nigeria) at least frame their gendered version as a preferential FAST-TRACK requiring some years of residence; Somalia's 1962 text grants it immediately and automatically, with zero residence requirement, for wives only. dual_citizenship_allowed set to TRUE per the same 2012 Constitution Article 8 reasoning disclosed in so_citizenship_naturalisation.json's notes.
